comments.hunk:
@@ -7,3 +18,3 @@
     """Yield independent rows; they remain readable after leaving this context."""
     with open(path, newline="") as source:
-        yield list(csv.DictReader(source))
+        yield LazyRows(source)
comments.body: The docstring promises the rows stay readable after the context exits, but LazyRows does not read the file until it is first iterated. A caller that iterates after the with block reads a closed file. Read the rows before the file closes.
